messages:
mira: Heads-up — AstraNimbus dedicated switchover tonight 23:00 UTC. Quiet window 22:30–00:30. Routing traffic to dedicated pool VPC-7. Need SRE/Platform/CS/security ack before we lock.

deploybot: Preflight checklist available — capacity check, certs, smoke tests. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/astranimbus-dedicated-swap (pin this).

sam (platform): Allocated reserved capacity and infra primed. No KMS rotations scheduled in window. Capacity verified. :white_check_mark:

jules (sre): Quick note on rollback thresholds: set automatic rollback if error rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > 1.2s for 5m. I'll watch metrics.

hana (prod-eng): Pinned runtime image: rwinference:v2026-04-12-rc3. Config: batch=auto, kv_cache=true, quant-profile=balanced.

amy (solutions): Customer-side: Alex (CS) confirmed they can hold test traffic and be online for the window. They want a 45m warmup after canary before 100%.

alex-cs: I'll be on for the whole window and will coordinate with customer ops. Will post any user-facing issues immediately.

deploybot: Preflight checks: capacity=OK, smoke-tests=OK, certs=OK, model-image=available. Scheduling canary rollout.

mira: Final go/no-go? Reply with :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to hold.

sam (platform): :thumbsup: from infra.

jules (sre): :thumbsup: will be oncall and monitoring. Defer to deploybot for canary orchestration.

hana (prod-eng): :thumbsup: verified image and config.

amy (solutions): :thumbsup: CS team ready.

alex-cs: :thumbsup: customer contact online.

mira: Locking in 23:00 UTC. Plan: canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> full. Metrics hooks: errors, p95, CPU/GPU util. Rollback per Jules' thresholds. Runbook linked above.

jules (sre): Deploy command for ops reference:
```
rb deploy --team=astranimbus --env=dedicated \
  --image=rwinference:v2026-04-12-rc3 \
  --canary=5%:10m,25%:15m --kv-cache=on
```

deploybot: Scheduled job queued for 1759876840 (23:00 UTC). Will post updates in-thread during rollout.

mira: Thanks all — I'll ping again 30m before to confirm final checks. If anyone flags a hold, state it here ASAP.
